reason: Conversation 1 asked sensible diagnostic questions (frost, vent airflow, fan noise), correctly diagnosed an iced evaporator from a defrost fault, kept the defrost parts as suspects rather than confirmed, advised not to buy anything yet, and gave a clear 24-48h manual defrost procedure with a recurrence check and engineer handoff. Conversation 2 opened with US-style units and a generic checklist, wrongly suggested a separate 'Twin Cooling' fridge coil before correcting itself, and mentioned button-combo forced defrost. It also suggested a hairdryer and DIY heater/sensor replacement, and said 'That confirms it' with overconfidence, though it did warn against chipping ice and recommended an engineer. Conversation 1 was more accurate, better calibrated and safer, with no hairdryer or heat guns, so it served the homeowner better.
